nodes.name: button.svelte

nodes.name: is-mobile.svelte.ts
nodes.summary: Reactive hook exposing an IsMobile class that tracks whether the viewport is below a 768px breakpoint via a Svelte MediaQuery.
nodes.languageNotes: A .svelte.ts rune module subclassing Svelte's reactive MediaQuery so the mobile flag stays reactive across the app.

nodes.name: IsMobile
nodes.summary: Extends Svelte's reactive MediaQuery to expose a boolean that is true when the viewport width is below the given mobile breakpoint (default 768px).

nodes.name: bindings.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated tauri-specta bindings that define the entire typed frontend↔Rust contract: the `commands` object (send, receive, pairing, identity, etc.), the `events` object, and all shared payload types.
nodes.languageNotes: Machine-generated by tauri-specta; wraps Tauri invoke/event APIs with typed Result unions and should never be hand-edited.

nodes.name: makeEvent
nodes.summary: Factory that builds a typed event helper binding listen/once/emit to the Tauri event API with serialize/deserialize payload mapping.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: The frontend↔core IPC bridge: re-exports the generated bindings and runtime shims, and wraps each Tauri command in a thin async helper that unwraps the tauri-specta Result and throws on error so the UI can use try/catch.
nodes.languageNotes: The `ok()` unwrapper converts Result-union returns into throwing promises; every exported wrapper (Send/Receive/pairing/etc.) delegates to a command on the generated `commands` object.
